site.name: Hollis & Rye — deliberately broken fixtures
site.description: Three agent networks that a conforming runtime must refuse, published so the refusals can be demonstrated over HTTP exactly as a real peer artifact would be fetched. Nothing here is part of the deli. The site's own manifest, one directory up, declares one network ('vouch') and does not list these: §3.2 requires an exact name match against the published manifest, so these are reachable by URL and invisible to discovery, which is the correct relationship.

networks.name: invalid
networks.description: Breaks in one nameable way: metadata.front_man names an agent that does not exist. The failure a real publisher ships, after renaming an agent and forgetting the metadata. It is valid JSON on purpose — a parse error would prove only that JSON.parse works and would never reach the validator.

networks.name: cycle-a
networks.description: Composes cycle-b, which composes this one back. A two-document cycle, not a self-reference: §6 says composition cycle, and composition is across networks.

networks.name: cycle-b
networks.description: The other half of the cycle. Valid on its own; it is the pair that is refused.
